nodes.description: A patent publication titled "Social medical network for diagnosis assistance" describing a method for diagnosis assistance using similarity between medical cases and experts in a common embedding space.

nodes.entity_id: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance
nodes.description: The title of patent US9589231B2, referring to a network-based system for assisting medical diagnosis.
nodes.id: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance

nodes.description: A method that exploits similarity between a new medical case and existing medical cases and experts embedded in a common embedding space to assist diagnosis.

A common space in which a new medical case, existing medical cases, and experts are embedded as multidimensional representations to enable similarity computation.<SEP>A multidimensional space in which existing medical cases, experts, and new medical cases are embedded as multidimensional representations.

A medical case submitted by a requester as part of a query request, which is embedded in the embedding space for comparison.<SEP>A case for which a diagnosis is sought, comprising a plurality of records relating to a specific patient, such as laboratory test results, images, symptom descriptions, patient monitor results, diagnoses, and prescribed medications and treatments.

A set of previously known medical cases embedded in the embedding space, used as candidates for similarity-based retrieval.<SEP>A set of prior medical cases each having a multidimensional representation in the embedding space.

A set of medical experts embedded in the embedding space, who may be selected to attempt to provide a diagnosis for a new case.<SEP>A set of experts each embedded in the embedding space based on information such as expert profiles, coded medical procedures performed, authored articles, and linked stored medical cases.

The party submitting a query request including a new medical case and selecting from available query types.<SEP>A user who submits a query request including a new medical case to the diagnosis assistance system.

A query type that returns a subset of existing medical cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.<SEP>A query type that returns a subset of existing cases based on a computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.

A query type that returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.<SEP>A query type that returns a subset of experts based on a computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.

A computed cost for a query, differing between query-for-experts and query-for-cases, with the query-for-experts cost being higher to encourage using query-for-cases first.<SEP>A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from the cost for a query-for-cases.

An ontology comprising a set of medical concepts joined by links, used to compute multidimensional representations of medical cases and experts.<SEP>An ontology that includes parts of the human body, biological functions, medical conditions, pharmacological substances, and combinations thereof, and may be based on the Unified Medical Language System.
Concepts in the medical ontology, each corresponding to a respective dimension in the multidimensional representation.
A representation of a medical case computed based on the medical ontology, used for embedding and similarity computation.

A matrix applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology when computing similarity.<SEP>A matrix applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology.
Parts of the human body included in the ontology.
Biological functions included in the ontology.
Medical conditions included in the ontology.
Pharmacological substances included in the ontology.
A processor used to perform at least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets, and computing query cost steps.
A medical ontology system on which the medical ontology used in the method is based.

A system comprising memory storing instructions and a processor for executing them, which receives query requests with new medical cases, embeds them, allows selection of query types, and returns subsets of cases or experts.

A computation between the representation of the new case and representations of existing cases or experts, applying a matrix of proximities to the multidimensional representation that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology.
A medical determination formulated by an expert for a new case provided to the expert.
A payment made to an expert for formulating a diagnosis.
A database from which documents are returned based on a computed similarity between the embedded new case and documents embedded in the embedding space.
A set of devices in a network for linking requesters and experts with the diagnosis assistance system.
A network comprising a diagnosis assistance system and a set of user devices for linking requesters and experts with the system.
A product comprising a non-transitory recording medium storing instructions that when executed on a computer cause the computer to perform the diagnosis assistance method.
A component in communication with memory for executing stored instructions.
A component storing instructions for performing the diagnosis assistance method.
